Support us with your review!

notes.title: Chapter 2 is now available!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31839364/69882d35da024a403fc20cbb28460404a8c6ce1d.gif

Chapter 2 is now available! 

Our protagonist approaches the top level, what kind of challenges will he face this time!

BugFixes/Improvements

     Chapter 2 is now available.


In development

Leaderboards.
More bug fixes. 


Words from the devs

It is no secret that the programmer of Deadly Escape has been struggling fixing bugs, but he isn't stopping. Slow.... but deadly, he continues to eradicate the opposition. Don't hesitate to post any new bugs you find into chapter 2 for him to work on a fix. We already have an update scheduled hours after release!

After chapter 2 and the upcoming leaderboard, it is up to you players to help us extend the content of the game. We plan on adding more chapters based on the journey of the player between chapter 1 and 2. The other setting we would like to tackle is "the outside", the underground facility lies below an asylum. Is it safe? who knows....

If you have liked the game so far, don't hesitate to support us with your review to help us bring bring these new chapters to life.

As always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Deadly Escape Update #1
notes.content:
Deadly Escape v1.0.13 is now online! 

BugFixes/Improvements

    The player will not get stuck anymore after repeatedly pressing the spawn door button when the door is already open.
    The generator will now activate even if you close the dialogue before it fully opens.
    Fixed some undead that were not attacking the player.
    Fixed some instances where "shoot barrel" was randomly appearing.
    The player will not turn towards the hatches and escape(without 
        "moonwalk").
    The undead coming out of the bottom left hatch will not moonwalk 
        anymore during the cutscene.
    Fixed the description of the key cards and fuses.
    After the game is over, the cursor will now show on the screen.
    When accessed via the pause menu, the fullscreen option will now 
       reflect what the player set via the main menu.
    The achievements are now online.
    Fixed the collision area of some props.
    Arranged several graphic layers that had an incorrect order.
    The boss will not get stuck anymore in the bottom left corner.
    Fixed some instances where the help and dialogues overlapped each 
       other.
    Fixed a bug where the guards NPC kept shooting after the undead 
        were already dead(no pun intended).
    Targeting Fixes, after shooting an exploding barrel, the target will now 
       position over the closest undead.



In development

Chapter2
Leaderboards.
More bug fixes. 


Words from the devs

We still have a lot of bugs to fix, thank you for your patience!
If you liked the game, support us with your review! this way we will be able to bring you as many chapters as possible!
Have you played Endless Horde? check it out if you have the chance. It is a minigame but it ties to the story. Can you guess how? One of the leftover notes gives you a hint.
Join our new group! Once we gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. Join us!


And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Deadly Escape is now available, 40% off!
notes.content:
We hope you enjoy Deadly Escape, get it now while the launch discount lasts.

At the time of release, Deadly Escape has chapter 1 available. We will add several other chapters as time goes by, starting with chapter 2. We hope to bring you several other chapters for free if the game does well enough.

The chapters won't be very long, but be careful... if you die, you will have to start the chapter all over.

Of course, what is a game without their players, please check out the game, help us dish out any bugs you may find by posting at the forums.

Incoming New Stuff

Chapter 2. Fight for survival against new enemies in the laboratory area!
Enabling the achievements 
Enabling the leaderboard 
Several bug fixes. The boss music seems to not activate(sometimes), a random undead ignoring the player etc.
Balancing. A couple tweaks to the game difficulty.

Words from the devs

Join our new group! Once gather enough members we'll give away cool stuff. Join us!
Deadly Escape has a different programmer than Endless Horde. We'll be supporting both games from now on!

And as always, thanks for your support!
